tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Screen background, dialog body, text-field face, selected tab face. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Panel tiles, list rows, dialog header and footer, unselected tab face. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Bottom band under light buttons and thumbs, hover face of an unselected tab. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: panel-hi
tokens.usage: 1-unit (2px) top edge of every panel tile, divider lines inside a dialog, top highlight of a selected tab.

tokens.name: panel-hi-strong
tokens.usage: Top highlight of an unselected tab and the dialog header's top edge.

tokens.name: panel-lo
tokens.usage: 1-unit line under a panel tile or row, drawn outside it.

tokens.name: tab-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom line of a selected tab.

tokens.name: raised-hi
tokens.usage: Top highlight of a hovered unselected tab. Also the pressed face of an unchecked box.

tokens.name: raised-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom line of a hovered unselected tab.

tokens.name: field-shade
tokens.usage: 2-unit shade under the top edge of a text field; the O glyph on an off switch.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: 2px outline around every control, 1 unit at design scale. Sampled from the Ore UI state sheets. On surface-panel it is 1.85:1 and on surface-page 1.30:1, far below the 3:1 floor for control boundaries; the source pairing is kept, so every control also carries a label and a glyph or shape for its state. Text on light faces uses it too.

tokens.name: light-100
tokens.usage: Hover face of secondary buttons, dropdown buttons and switch thumbs.

tokens.name: light-100-hi
tokens.usage: Top and left highlight on a light-100 face.

tokens.name: light-100-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom and right line on a light-100 face.

tokens.name: light-200
tokens.usage: Face of secondary buttons, dropdown buttons, slider and switch thumbs; also disabled faces. As text it is ink-muted. Text on it: ink-dark.

tokens.name: light-200-hi
tokens.usage: Top and left highlight on a light-200 face.

tokens.name: light-200-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom and right line on a light-200 face.

tokens.name: light-300
tokens.usage: Pressed face of secondary buttons and dropdown buttons, disabled band, field placeholder text.

tokens.name: light-300-hi
tokens.usage: Top and left highlight on a pressed light face.

tokens.name: light-300-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom and right line on a pressed light face.

tokens.name: light-400
tokens.usage: Outline of every disabled control; face of an unchecked box, the empty slider segments and an off switch track.

tokens.name: grey-hi
tokens.usage: Top and left highlight on an unchecked box, empty slider segment or off switch track.

tokens.name: grey-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom and right line on those faces.

tokens.name: grey-hover
tokens.usage: Hover face of an unchecked box.

tokens.name: grey-hover-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom and right line of a hovered unchecked box.

tokens.name: grey-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed face of an unchecked box.

tokens.name: grey-pressed-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom and right line of a pressed unchecked box.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Face of hero and primary buttons, checked box and diamond, on switch track, selected toggle segment, slider fill. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: green-hi
tokens.usage: Top and left highlight on a green face.

tokens.name: green-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom and right line on a green face.

tokens.name: green-edge
tokens.usage: 2-unit dark band under a green button.

tokens.name: green-shade
tokens.usage: Drop shadow of the hero button's label, offset 2px right and down.

tokens.name: green-hover
tokens.usage: Hover face of green controls. White text on it is 3.1:1, below 4.5:1; the source pairing is kept and the hero label is bold caps.

tokens.name: green-hover-hi
tokens.usage: Top and left highlight on a hovered green face.

tokens.name: green-hover-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom and right line on a hovered green face.

tokens.name: green-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed face of green controls. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: green-pressed-hi
tokens.usage: Top and left highlight on a pressed green face.

tokens.name: green-pressed-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom and right line on a pressed green face.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Face of the destructive button. Always paired with a word. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: red-hi
tokens.usage: Top and left highlight on a red face.

tokens.name: red-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom and right line on a red face.

tokens.name: red-edge
tokens.usage: 2-unit dark band under a red button.

tokens.name: red-hover
tokens.usage: Hover face of the destructive button and the warning tag. White text on it is 2.4:1, below 4.5:1; the source pairing is kept. Tag text on it is ink-dark.

tokens.name: red-hover-hi
tokens.usage: Top and left highlight on a hovered red face.

tokens.name: red-hover-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom and right line on a hovered red face.

tokens.name: red-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed face of the destructive button.

tokens.name: red-pressed-hi
tokens.usage: Top and left highlight on a pressed red face.

tokens.name: red-pressed-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom and right line on a pressed red face.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Info notice, tooltip and progress fill. Sampled from the in-game screenshots, not from the state sheets. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Important notice bar and the notice tag. Text on it: ink-dark.

tokens.name: tag-neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral tag fill. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: tag-primary
tokens.usage: Primary tag fill. Text on it: ink-dark.

tokens.name: tag-info
tokens.usage: Informative tag fill. Text on it: ink-dark.

tokens.name: tag-notice
tokens.usage: Notice tag fill. Text on it: ink-dark.

tokens.name: tag-warning
tokens.usage: Warning tag fill. Text on it: ink-dark.

tokens.name: tag-realms
tokens.usage: Realms informative tag fill. Text on it: ink-dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-page, surface-panel, surface-raised and every colored face.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, help text and secondary lines on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in a text field.

tokens.name: ink-dark
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on light-100, light-200, light-300 and tag faces.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Text on disabled light faces.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px, drawn directly outside the control outline; a text field leaves a 2px gap.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen hero titles, set in capitals, one per screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Dialog titles, panel headers, row labels, hero button text in capitals.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Field values, short dialog copy and tab text in the pixel font.
styles.sample: This removes the world and its backups.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Descriptions, data columns, help text, tags and tooltips.

styles.name: prose
styles.usage: Long running copy inside dialogs and announcements, set in Noto Sans, never in the pixel font.
styles.sample: Lemon drops lollipop jelly beans powder brownie.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: One design unit is 2px. Gap between a label and its control, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row and button vertical padding, gap between controls in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, button horizontal padding, gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen margins, gap between sections.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every control, panel, tab, tag and thumb is square.

tokens.name: radius-pixel
tokens.usage: Tooltip bubble only, a one-pixel stepped corner.

tokens.name: panel-tile
tokens.usage: Panel tiles and list rows: a 2px light top edge and a 2px dark line beneath. Matches panel-hi and panel-lo.

tokens.name: field-well
tokens.usage: Text fields and progress tracks: a 4px shade under the top outline. Matches field-shade.
